device.name: Bluetooth LED Name Badge
device.notes: 11x44 monochrome LED dot matrix badge. Sold under many brands on AliExpress. Protocol is write-only (no reads). 16-byte BLE writes, 64-byte header + bitmap data. No pairing required. Device stores messages in flash and persists across power cycles. Up to 8 message slots with individual animation modes.

write_badge_data.description: Write badge payload in 16-byte chunks. Payload structure: Bytes 0-3: Header 0x77616E67 ("wang"). Byte 4: 0x00 reserved. Byte 5: brightness (0x00=100%, 0x10=75%, 0x20=50%, 0x40=25%). Byte 6: flash flags (8-bit bitfield, bit N = message N blinks). Byte 7: marquee flags (8-bit bitfield, bit N = message N has animated border). Bytes 8-15: speed+mode per message ((speed << 4) | mode). Bytes 16-31: message sizes (2 bytes big-endian per message, up to 8 messages). Bytes 32-37: padding. Bytes 38-43: timestamp (YY MM DD HH MM SS). Bytes 44-63: padding. Bytes 64+: bitmap data (11 bytes per character column).
